findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Переклади іспанською: «Що ви робите в парку?» (питаєш кількох друзів)."; task.errors[0]: "¿Qué hacen en el parque?" has outcome "unresolved".
findings.description: The prompt specifies friends but does not fix the regional form of address. The key credits vosotros/hacéis while leaving the explicitly reviewed informal ustedes/hacen reading unresolved. Its own feedback recognizes that reading in parts of Spain. The intended regional grading standard remains unspecified.
findings.suggestion: Explicitly require vosotros/vosotras, or accept regional informal ustedes/hacen answers as correct.

items.reviewerAnswer: ¿Qué hacéis en el parque? Also possible with explicit vosotros/vosotras. ¿Qué hacen en el parque? fits regional informal ustedes usage.
items.notes: The regional explanation is reasonable. The concern is the explicitly reviewed alternative, not an assumption that every unlisted answer is graded incorrect.
sources: Course contract, rule 3: accepted contains every reviewed acceptable answer; verdict instructions concerning unspecified region and multiple readings.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «usted», discussion of regional plural ustedes replacing vosotros (from memory).
